title: You get what you pay for.
text: You get what you pay for.. Very nice looking fabric, fit all my pillows. Unfortunately, within a week on of the pillow seams fell apart. You get what you pay for.

product_metadata.title: Home Brilliant Grey Throw Pillow Cover Decorative Throw Pillow Case Lined Linen for Bed Couch Sofa, 20x20(50cm), Light Grey
features: Material: Made of High quality durable linen blend, comfortable to touch and lay on. Quality fabric, hide your old pillow patterns perfectly.
Size: 20x20 inch/ 50x50cm(1-2cm deviation). Package contains 1 piece of pillow cover, NO PILLOW INCLUDED.
Craftsmanship : use color coordinated hidden zipper closure for an elegant look. Tight zigzag over-lock stitches to avoid fraying and ripping.
Gift and Decor: Great gift for each holiday, matches with any color bed, couch, sofa, car, or chair. Matching table runner and placemat are available at Home Brilliant
Washing guide: Machine washable, separately from other articles, gentle circle in low. No bleach.

details.Warranty Description: All products purchased have a 90-day warranty as standard. The warranty period begins on the day the product is originally shipped. The warranty covers all of the items and conditions identified in the original manufacturers warranty. Some of the items specifically not covered by the warranty are loss and theft, water damage, customer abuse.
